industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Janus Electric Holdings Limited
summary: Janus Electric Holdings Ltd. focuses its efforts on pinpointing and developing environmentally friendly hydrogen initiatives, while also strategically deploying capital into sustainable and clean energy innovations to deliver benefits to its stakeholders. Its business activities are organized into three primary divisions: Hydrogen; Renewable and Clean Energy Investments; and Corporate. Lambertus de Graaf founded the firm in November 2000, and its principal office is located in Milton, Australia.
